title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 134. Believes that the EU’s objective to achieve climate neutrality while enhancing its competitiveness can only be reached through gradual industrial transformation while reflecting the diverse national and regional circumstances of its Member States; underlines that investing in productivity and industrial value chains for home-grown, low- and net-zero technologies, raw materials, innovation, skills and infrastructure within the EU is essential to increase the EU’s strategic autonomy; stresses that the transformation should be carried out within realistic timeframes; underlines the importance of safe digital technologies in supporting industrial transformation;
